items.description:
All these tools do the same core thing: transcribe your speech and paste it wherever your cursor is. The differences come down to platform, engine preference, and how much you want beyond basic dictation.
A few starting points:

items.title: Cross-platform default: Handy
items.description: . Biggest open-source project in this list, runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

items.title: On macOS, want a native feel: VoiceInk
items.description: or FluidVoice.

items.title: Want cloud providers or AI transformations on top: Whispering
items.description: or OpenWhispr.

items.title: Just Tell Me What to Use

items.description: : means on-device speech recognition. means the tool supports both local and cloud or BYO-cloud setups.

items.title: Amical
items.description: macOS, Windows Local Whisper Context-aware dictation that adapts formatting to the app you are using.

items.title: Buzz
items.description: Linux, macOS, Windows Local Whisper, Whisper.cpp, Faster Whisper Desktop app for microphone or file transcription; text stays in its own UI rather than typing into other apps.

items.title: Chirp
items.description: Windows Local Parakeet TDT Dictates into Windows apps, runs on CPU only, and is aimed at locked-down corporate environments.

items.title: Elograf
items.description: Linux Local Vosk (via nerd-dictation) GUI tray frontend for nerd-dictation with model switching and timeout controls.

items.title: Epicenter Whispering
items.description: Linux, macOS, Windows, Web Hybrid Whisper Local-first dictation with a global shortcut and multiple Whisper providers; also available as a Chrome extension and web app.

items.title: FluidVoice
items.description: macOS Hybrid Parakeet, Apple Speech, Whisper macOS dictation app that can type into any app and switch between local speech engines.

items.title: FnKey
items.description: macOS Hybrid Deepgram Nova-3, Groq Whisper Rust menu bar app that activates the microphone only while holding Fn, with real-time streaming and batch cloud backends.

items.title: Ghost Pepper
items.description: macOS Local WhisperKit Hold-to-talk menu bar dictation with local LLM cleanup of filler words; runs entirely on Apple Silicon.

items.title: Handy
items.description: Linux, macOS, Windows Local Whisper.cpp, Parakeet TDT Shortcut-driven offline dictation built with Tauri and supporting several ASR model families.

items.title: HNS
items.description: Linux, macOS, Windows Local Faster Whisper CLI tool that records from your mic, transcribes locally, and copies the result to the clipboard.

items.title: hyprwhspr
items.description: Linux Hybrid Whisper.cpp, Parakeet, BYOK cloud Push-to-talk Linux dictation with a visualizer plus Waybar and systemd integration.

items.title: nerd-dictation
items.description: Linux Local Vosk Hackable offline dictation that types into any window via simulated keystrokes.

items.title: Offline Voice Input (Android)
items.description: Android Local Parakeet TDT Offline Android voice input keyboard with live subtitles and a privacy-first focus.

items.title: OmniDictate
items.description: Windows Local Whisper Desktop dictation tool aimed at type-anywhere workflows.

items.title: OpenSuperWhisper
items.description: macOS Local Whisper, Parakeet Native Swift menu bar dictation app optimized for Apple Silicon and global shortcuts.

items.title: OpenWhispr
items.description: Linux, macOS, Windows Hybrid Whisper.cpp, Parakeet, BYOK cloud Cross-platform dictation with local models, optional cloud providers, and a custom dictionary.

items.title: Pindrop
items.description: macOS Local WhisperKit Offline menu bar dictation app with optional AI-based transcript cleanup.

items.title: Speak to AI
items.description: Linux Local Whisper.cpp Minimal Linux dictation tool that inserts text into the active window and can also run from the CLI.

items.title: Tambourine Voice
items.description: macOS, Windows Hybrid Faster Whisper, BYOK cloud Voice interface for any app with configurable STT and LLM providers.

items.title: Transcribro
items.description: Android Local Whisper.cpp Private and on-device speech recognition keyboard and service for Android.

items.title: TypeWhisper
items.description: macOS Hybrid Whisper (local and/or cloud) Voice typing app with both local and cloud engine options.

items.title: Vibe
items.description: Linux, macOS, Windows Local Whisper.cpp Desktop app to transcribe audio and video offline using OpenAI Whisper.

items.title: Vocalinux
items.description: Linux Local Whisper.cpp, Whisper, Vosk Linux dictation with distro-specific setup guides and Vulkan acceleration notes.

items.title: VoiceInk
items.description: macOS Hybrid WhisperKit, BYOK Native macOS dictation with per-app tuning, a custom dictionary, and optional commercial distribution.

items.title: VoiceTypr
items.description: macOS, Windows Local Whisper-based Voice-to-text dictation built with Tauri; the repository is open source, but binaries require a one-time license purchase.

items.title: Voquill
items.description: Linux, macOS, Windows Hybrid Whisper.cpp, BYOK cloud Cross-platform voice typing with a personal glossary and AI-assisted cleanup.

items.title: VOXD
items.description: Linux Local Whisper.cpp Linux dictation with GUI, tray, and CLI modes plus optional LLM post-processing.

items.title: VoxType
items.description: Linux Hybrid Whisper.cpp, Parakeet, Moonshine, SenseVoice Push-to-talk Linux dictation with seven engine choices, CJK support, and Wayland-optimized text insertion.

items.title: WhisperBoard
items.description: iOS Local Whisper.cpp iOS app for recording speech and producing text with downloadable Whisper models.

items.title: Whisper IME
items.description: Android Local Whisper.cpp Android keyboard and standalone app powered by Whisper, fully offline, and available on F-Droid.

items.title: whisper-writer
items.description: Linux, macOS, Windows Hybrid Faster Whisper, OpenAI API Hotkey-driven dictation that auto-types into the active window with several recording modes.

items.title: whisper_dictation
items.description: Linux Local Whisper.cpp Feature-rich Linux voice keyboard with dictation, voice commands, and webcam integration.

items.title: Yap
items.description: macOS Local Apple Speech Native macOS 26 menu bar dictation using Apple's SpeechAnalyzer for streaming on-device transcription.

items.title: Directory

items.description: Speech recognition engines, models, and APIs that power the tools listed above.

items.title: whisper.cpp
items.description: Pure C/C++ Whisper inference with zero dependencies; runs on Apple Silicon, CUDA, Vulkan, and WASM.

items.title: Faster Whisper
items.description: CTranslate2-based Whisper reimplementation; up to 4x faster with lower memory.

items.title: Vosk
items.description: Lightweight offline ASR with compact models, 20+ languages, and multi-language bindings.

items.title: WhisperKit
items.description: Swift package for on-device Whisper on Apple Silicon with streaming support.

items.title: Awesome Whisper
items.description: Curated list of Whisper tools and resources.
